name: CA-24
label: Safe D

key_factors: Carbajal's massive financial advantage ($3.4M cash vs $47K)
Incumbent seeking re-election with no serious outside spending against him
Prediction markets price Democratic win near certainty
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Carbajal: a D+13 district, incumbency, and a lopsided fundraising edge of over $3.3 million in cash on hand against a little-known challenger. Markets price a Democratic win at roughly 98%, and no polls or expert ratings suggest any reason to move away from the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Carbajal or a strong Republican fundraising quarter could narrow the margin, though a seat this blue is unlikely to flip.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Salud Carbajal seeks another term in a Central Coast district that leans Democratic by about 13 points. He enters the general election with a commanding financial position, holding $3.4 million in cash after raising $1.65 million, while Republican Bob Smith has raised about $203,000 with only $47,000 on hand. No outside groups have invested meaningfully in the race on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the contest, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the incumbent's resources, and prediction markets, which price a Democratic win near 98%. The race is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty being the size of the margin rather than the winner.
